prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished vertical portrait illustration for the Arcanista class of the D20Age old-school tabletop RPG, intended for a large character-selection card and character-sheet portrait. The two attached images are STYLE REFERENCES only: match their dense hand-drawn black ink crosshatching, gritty vintage 1980s fantasy RPG engraving, stark black shadows on white paper, detailed textured lines. Subject: one human wandering arcanist in a weathered pointed hat and layered travel robes, holding a wooden staff in one hand and a small rune-inscribed book in the other, clearly visible face and hands, practical belt and travel pouch. A subtle ruined stone arch and sparse mist in the background, much simpler than the references so the figure remains readable at card size. Composition: centered single figure, head to boots, portrait 2:3, generous breathing room around hat, staff, and boots, clear silhouette, detailed natural anatomy and clothing rather than geometric/cartoon icon shapes. Monochrome black ink and white paper only. No lettering, no logo, no frame, no skulls, no skeletons, no UI. Create entirely new art, do not reproduce the scene or characters of the references.
